commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+8' The goal by Rennes won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
90+8' Attention! Referee Benoit Millot straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
90+8' Rennes have a goal ruled out for offside!
90+6' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Rennes, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+4' Deiver Machado (Lens) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Benoit Millot blows his whistle for a foul. Rennes have a free kick.
90+2' Desire Doue (Rennes) takes the corner but it's cleared.
90+1' The resulting set piece from Rennes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Rennes will have a chance to score from a corner.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
88' Florian Sotoca (Lens) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
83' Benoit Millot shows a yellow card to Christopher Wooh (Rennes) for his blatant foul.
83' The substitution has been made. Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) has replaced David Pereira da Costa.
82' 1 - 1 Goal! Arnaud Kalimuendo plays a simple square pass into the feet of Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the top right corner. 1:1.
81' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Rennes, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

81' Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Benoit Millot stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Rennes have been awarded a free kick.

78' Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
77' Substitution. Ludovic Blas (Rennes) has come on for Enzo Le Fee.
76' Bertug Yildirim (Rennes) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Brice Samba anticipates well and smothers the ball.
74' Alidu Seidu (Rennes) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
73' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Lens is cautioned for aggressive play. That's a free kick to Rennes.
72' Substitution. Wesley Said makes way for Morgan Guilavogui (Lens).
72' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Angelo Fulgini will be replaced by Adrien Thomasson (Lens).
71' Przemyslaw Frankowski goes off the pitch and Ruben Aguilar (Lens) comes on.
69' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header directed into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop his effort.
69' A cross into the box from Wesley Said (Lens) is cleared.
67' Substitution. Benjamin Bourigeaud did his best and is replaced by Ibrahim Salah (Rennes).
67' Julien Stephan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bertug Yildirim (Rennes) replacing Amine Gouiri.
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Fabian Rieder (Rennes) comes onto the pitch so that Baptiste Santamaria can be given a rest.
64' Desire Doue (Rennes) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Brice Samba, who makes a comfortable save.
63' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post.
61' Florian Sotoca (Lens) serves up a nice cross, but Steve Mandanda punches the ball away.
60' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
57' Arthur Theate (Rennes) is being substituted because of an injury. Julien Stephan sends Jeanuel Belocian on the pitch.
55' Arthur Theate (Rennes) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
55' Nampalys Mendy (Lens) was too forceful with his tackle and Benoit Millot interrupted the game to signal a free kick. A free kick has been awarded to Rennes.
54' Wesley Said (Lens) is flagged for offside.
51' Rennes seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
48' 0 - 1 What an excellent finish! Angelo Fulgini (Lens) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and lashes the ball into the roof of the net. Unstoppable shot!

47' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Lens win a free kick.
46' Benoit Millot interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Deiver Machado (Lens). Rennes have a free kick.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Benoit Millot blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Desire Doue (Rennes) zig-zags his way into the box and fails to direct a shot inside the left post. The goalkeeper pulls off a miraculous stop.
45+2' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot goalwards, but Steve Mandanda gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
42' Alidu Seidu (Rennes) has tested the patience of referee Benoit Millot and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
40' Alidu Seidu (Rennes) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Lens.
38' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) meets a cross inside the box, but Brice Samba wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
36' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
35' Facundo Medina (Lens) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Millot had an easy-decision to make.
32' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom left corner, but Brice Samba is equal to it and makes an easy save.
32' Facundo Medina (Lens) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Rennes get a free kick.
30' Lens take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
29' Lens failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

28' Wesley Said (Lens) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lens.
28' The free kick is taken by Angelo Fulgini (Lens), but ball is cleared. The ball is out of play and Lens manage to earn a corner.
27' A player from Rennes commits a rough challenge. Benoit Millot blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Lens are awarded the free kick.
25' A dangerous looking corner kick from Angelo Fulgini (Lens) is cleared to safety by the defence.
24' Flag goes up against Wesley Said (Lens) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
22' Alidu Seidu (Rennes) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Lens will take a free kick.
22' A lofted cross from Adrien Truffert (Rennes) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
21' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by David Pereira da Costa (Lens) was quite harsh and Benoit Millot didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
18' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Steve Mandanda makes a comfortable save.
18' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
17' Looks like Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
16' Nampalys Mendy (Lens) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
15' A pass from Desire Doue (Rennes) is intercepted by Brice Samba and the move breaks down.
15' Rennes quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
13' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. Rennes have a corner.
11' Wesley Said (Lens) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Benoit Millot has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Rennes are awarded a free kick.

10' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post.
10' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
10' Desire Doue (Rennes) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Rennes will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
9' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) makes a strong challenge and Benoit Millot blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Rennes, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
7' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.
6' CLOSE! Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the left post!
4' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
2' It doesn’t look good for Jonathan Gradit (Lens); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Rennes will have the kick-off.
Benoit Millot will referee today's match.
